intro: In the heart of Kamphaeng Phet, right by the Ping River and Sirichit Park, sits a long-established hotel locals know well: Chakungrao Riverview Hotel. It is a riverside property of around 111 rooms whose clear selling point is that every room has its own private balcony overlooking either the Ping River or the city, decorated in a simple Thai style with wooden floors. It has a swimming pool, an on-site restaurant and free parking. What reviewers consistently praise is the central riverside location, within walking distance of the night market and old town. body.html: Chakungrao Riverview Hotel is a 3-star riverside hotel on the Ping River in the centre of Kamphaeng Phet, on Thesa 1 Road in the Nai Mueang sub-district. It is a long-running property of around 111 rooms that locals know well, set right beside the riverfront and Sirichit Park, within easy walking distance of the night market and old town. Most guests who choose it are people in town on business, travellers who want a central base that is easy to explore on foot, and visitors heading to Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park, which is only a few minutes' drive away.

Rooms come in two main types: Superior at around 30 sqm with a double or twin beds, and the roomier Deluxe at about 35 sqm. The detail every review mentions is that every room has its own private balcony looking out over the Ping River or the town, decorated in a simple Thai style, with many rooms featuring warm wooden floors. All rooms have air conditioning, a TV, a fridge and a private bathroom with a shower. Guests frequently praise the clean rooms, comfortable beds, and the pleasure of sipping morning coffee on the balcony overlooking the river.

"A room right by the Ping River, a balcony you can relax on, friendly and helpful staff, a central location you can walk to the night market and the riverfront from, easy parking, and good value for the price."

The facilities are well-rounded for this class of hotel. There is a swimming pool, an on-site restaurant serving Thai and international dishes, a buffet breakfast, free parking, free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk. It also has meeting rooms and handles banquets, so you will see both leisure guests and people in town for conferences. The one thing to accept is that the hotel has been open for a good while, and parts of the building and some rooms look dated compared with newer hotels, even though it has been renovated in phases.

Location is the hotel's strongest card. It sits right beside Sirichit Park and the Ping River, about 100 metres from the Kamphaeng Phet night market, and within walking distance of the old town and riverside eateries. Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park is around a 5–10 minute drive away, and it is an easy onward drive to Sukhothai. It suits anyone who wants to stay in the centre and explore at night without driving. The overall score sits around 7.4 from real reviews, with platforms mainly praising the location and river views, while the points it loses come from the ageing condition of some rooms.

To be straight with you, Chakungrao Riverview Hotel is a central riverside hotel that sells its location and Ping River views, not a brand-new property with sleek modern rooms. If you expect rooms as crisp as a newly opened hotel, some may feel dated, and room standards are not always consistent. But if you see it as a central riverside stay where every room has a river-view balcony, with a pool, a restaurant and free parking at an affordable starting price, all within walking distance of the night market and old town, it stands out for value and location among Kamphaeng Phet's city-centre hotels.

Tips from reading through the reviews: request a river-facing room when booking if you want the best view and a quieter side, since some rooms face the city or the interior. Ask to see a recently renovated room before checking in if that option is available, to avoid the more dated ones. Having your own car is convenient thanks to the free parking, but even without one you can comfortably explore the centre on foot. In the evening, walk out to the nearby night market and riverfront for plenty of good local food. And always compare the live price on Agoda and Booking before you book, as rates shift with the season and promotions.

honestSummary: Chakungrao Riverview Hotel is a riverside hotel in central Kamphaeng Phet for travellers who want a central riverside location, a river-view balcony in every room, a pool, a restaurant and free parking at an affordable starting price. The location, river views and value are genuine strengths — but you have to accept that the hotel has been open a long time, parts of it and some rooms look dated, and room standards are not always consistent.
honestChecks: If you expect crisp, brand-new rooms like a freshly opened hotel — this is a long-established property and some rooms look dated → choose a newer hotel in town, or ask to see a renovated room before checking in.
If you want a river-view room — not every room faces the river; some face the city → specify a river-facing room when booking.
If you are travelling with family and want a larger room — choose the 35 sqm Deluxe over the Superior → it is more spacious and comfortable for several people.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Chakungrao Riverview Hotel Kamphaeng Phet

faq.q: Where is Chakungrao Riverview Hotel and what is nearby?
faq.a: It is at 149 Thesa 1 Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Kamphaeng Phet, right by the Ping River and Sirichit Park in the heart of town. It is about 100 metres from the Kamphaeng Phet night market and within walking distance of the old town and riverfront. Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park is about a 5–10 minute drive away, making it ideal for anyone who wants to stay central and explore at night.

faq.q: How much does Chakungrao Riverview Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about ฿850/night for a city-view Superior. There are also river-view Superior rooms from around ฿1,000, river-view Deluxe rooms from around ฿1,300, and larger/renovated rooms from around ฿1,500. Every room has a private balcony. Rates move with the season and promotions, so always compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Chakungrao Riverview Hotel best for?
faq.a: It is best for people in town on business, travellers who want a central, walkable base, and visitors to Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park who want a riverside stay where every room has a river-view balcony, with a pool and a restaurant, at an affordable starting price. It suits those who value location and value over brand-new, plush rooms.

faq.q: Does Chakungrao Riverview Hotel have a pool and what facilities are there?
faq.a: Yes — there is a swimming pool, an on-site restaurant serving Thai and international food, a buffet breakfast, free parking, free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk. It also has meeting rooms and handles banquets. The thing to accept is that some areas and rooms show their age, as the hotel has been open for a good while.

faq.q: What are the rooms at Chakungrao Riverview Hotel like?
faq.a: Rooms split into Superior (around 30 sqm) and Deluxe (around 35 sqm). Every room has a private balcony overlooking the Ping River or the city, decorated in simple Thai style, many with wooden floors. They have air conditioning, a TV, a fridge and a private bathroom with a shower. Note that room standards are not consistent across all rooms — some are dated — so request a river-facing or recently renovated room when booking.

faq.q: Are the review scores for Chakungrao Riverview Hotel reliable?
faq.a: The overall score sits around 7.4 from real reviews across platforms, with Booking around 7.3 and Agoda around 7.5. The strengths reviewers agree on are the central riverside location and the river views from the balconies, while the points it loses come from the ageing condition of some rooms. It is a good fit if you want a central riverside stay focused on location and value in Kamphaeng Phet.
